और (।।) उि सारणी के स्ट् तम्भ (2) में जर्जिर्िाष्ट अजधकारी को ररटर्ििंग आदिसर की उसके कृत्यों के पालि में सहायता के जलए सहायक ररटर्ििंग आदिसर जियुि करता है। सारणी ररटर्ििंग आदिसर के रू प में पिाजभजहत अजधकारी सहायक ररटर्ििंग आदिसर के रू प में जियुि अजधकारी (1) (2) श्र ी राम लोक खटाणा, सजचर् , पंिाब जर्धाि सभा सजचर्ालय श्र ी िसवर्ंिर वसंह, उप सजचर् , पंिाब जर्धाि सभा सजचर्ालय [िा. सं. 100/रा.स.- पंिाब/02/2025(2)] आिेि से, सुमि कुमार िास, सजचर् सं. 43] िई दिल्ली , सोमर्ार , अक्तू बर 6, 2025/आज र् ि 14, 1947 No. 43] NEW DELHI, MONDAY, OCTOBER 6, 2025/ASVINA 14, 1947 सी.जी.-डी.एल.-अ.-06102025-266683 CG-DL-E-06102025-266683 -- 1 of 2 -- 2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(iii)] ELECTION COMMISSION OF INDIA NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 6th October, 2025 O.N. 43 (E).—In pursuance of Section 21, and in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 22 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 (43 of 1951), the Election Commission, in consultation with the Government of the State of Punjab, hereby- (i) designates the officer, specified in column (1) of the TABLE below, to be the Returning Officer; and (ii) appoints the officers, specified in column (2) of the said TABLE, to be the Assistant Returning Officer to assist the Returning Officer in the performance of his functions; in respect of the bye-election to the Council of States, to be held in the State in pursuance of the Commission’s Notification, published in the Gazette of India on 6th October, 2025: - TABLE Officer Designated as Returning Officer Officer Appointed as Assistant Returning Officer (1) (2) Shri Ram Lok Khatana, Secretary, Punjab Vidhan Sabha Secretariat Shri Jaswinder Singh, Deputy Secretary, Punjab Vidhan Sabha Secretariat [F. No. 100/CS-PB/02/2025 (2)] By Order, SUMAN KUMAR DAS, Secy.
